title: Nourishing Canadian Tomatoes Hash
description: A pungent, flaky, lazy-sunday Canadian dish featuring tomatoes, mantecare-emulsify, paleo-friendly. Perfect for a weekend brunch or casual dinner.

ingredients.name: 2 tablespoons manteca (lard)
ingredients.notes: or substitute with coconut oil or avocado oil for vegan option

instructions: Heat the manteca in a large cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped garlic and saut0 until fragrant.
Add the chopped tomatoes and cook until they release their juices and start to break down.
Add the beaten eggs and stir until the eggs start to set.
Add the chopped parsley and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Optional: add diced red onion and stir to combine.
Cook until the eggs are fully set and the tomatoes are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
